text:
Ruth (People Ops): Heads-up 11 new hire Jonah (Infra PM) starts next Monday 10am PT. Dropping a short manager-first-week cheat we can copy into calendar invites.
Diego (Eng Manager): Thanks Ruth. Want a compact plan so I don't miss anything. Can we get laptop + basic cloud roles pre-provisioned?
Marta (IT): Laptop order queued. Diego - confirm mac/linux and whether they need an external monitor. Also supply the Slack channels for auto-join.
Diego (Eng Manager): MacBook Pro 14\", add to #infra, #oncall, #pm-hq. Cloud: aws-staging-read, github-org, jira-dev.
Ruth (People Ops): Copyable manager-first-week cheat: 
```
Before day 1: submit device + Okta, invite to Slack, add to payroll, upload signed offer to #people-ops-private.
Day 1 AM: 10am manager intro (20m), badge + MFA smoke test, buddy intro.
Day 1 PM: 1pm \"first-week map\" send, 3pm infra walkthrough shadow.
Day 2-3: dev env + repo access, small onboarding task (sandbox secret rotate + PR).
Week 1: daily short 1:1s, runbook tour, shadow oncall.
30/60/90 example: 30 learn & ship small change; 60 own a component; 90 propose measurable reliability work.
Feedback checkpoints: day3, week2, week4, then monthly.
```
Eli (Buddy): I'll be Jonah's buddy. I'll schedule a 1pm Day1 coffee and attach a 1-pager with \"who to ping\" (IT, Security, Oncall, Docs).
Diego (Eng Manager): For the small task I want Jonah to rotate a demo secret in sandbox and open a PR to exercise CI. Good balance of infra + process.
Jun (Security): We'll provide a 10-15m security overview on Day1 afternoon and share a short pre-read (secrets-and-creds.md). No prod creds used in onboarding tasks.
Marta (IT): Sandbox service account provisioned w/ 1h TTL tokens. I'll DM the ephemeral token workflow to Jonah and Diego. Laptop imaging ETA: Fri EOD, pickup Mon 9am.
OnboardBot: New-hire checklist created: https://onboard.example/2249876543 :tada: 
Diego (Eng Manager): Can we add a calendar note for timezone visibility & working hours? Last time there were missed invites.
Ruth (People Ops): Added timezone visibility to the cheat. Also included a reminder to confirm any contract addenda (NDAs, addenda) before Day1.
Eli (Buddy): Suggest adding a \"first PR reviewer\" line so Jonah knows who to ping for PR reviews during week1. I'll recommend Lina on infra.
Diego (Eng Manager): Good call. Lina will be the first reviewer. Also scheduling a Tues 30m sync with platform lead to brief on current priorities.
Jun (Security): Pre-read sent. I'll host live 15m on Mon 4pm and include 6 quick actions for secrets handling.
Marta (IT): I'll post the laptop pickup location + instructions in Jonah's welcome DM.
Ruth (People Ops): All set 16; Diego, drop the signed offer into #people-ops-private when you have a moment.
Diego (Eng Manager): Will do. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: Looking forward to welcoming Jonah.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: manager check-in (day3) and 30/60/90 template reminder at day30.
